payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for various models used in cyberbullying detection, including the effects of oversampling and transfer learning on precision and recall.

claims.text: Oversampling bullying posts improved performance across all DNN models, with significant improvements in evaluation measures compared to non-oversampled datasets.
Transfer learning (TL1) showed higher precision but lower recall for the Formspring dataset compared to Twitter, indicating different characteristics of cyberbullying across datasets.
Feature Level Transfer Learning (TL2) resulted in dramatic improvements in recall and significant improvements in precision compared to TL1.
DNN models with transfer learning achieved better F1 scores than previous best-known results for the Wikipedia and Twitter datasets.
